LESSON: PRINT AWARENESS

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.3: Print awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Print awareness. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What pictures interest of school. • Learners could answer questions about learners?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate awareness of pictures. print in and out of school. • Learners could be engaged in ‘read aloud’
2. Show interest in reading in and activities. out of school. • Learners could view pictures depicting a

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Demonstrate awareness of pictures. print in and out of school. • Learners could be engaged in ‘read aloud’
   In simple words: practise until you can demonstrate awareness of pictures. print in and out of school. • Learners could be engaged in ‘read aloud’. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Show interest in reading in and activities. out of school. • Learners could view pictures depicting a
   In simple words: practise until you can show interest in reading in and activities. out of school. • Learners could view pictures depicting a. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Print awareness using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Print awareness in the examples.
2. Explain Print awareness to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Print awareness.
4. Show that you can: Demonstrate awareness of pictures. print in and out of school. • Learners could be engaged in ‘read aloud’

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Print awareness using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Print awareness important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Answer questions about learners? b) Demonstrate awareness of pictures. print in and out of school.
2. Be engaged in ‘read aloud’ c) Show interest in reading in and activities. out of school.
3. View pictures depicting a d) Enjoy reading pictures in and story during a read aloud session. out of school.
4. Be guided to view and talk about recorded picture clips and answer questions about them.
5. View picture cut outs depicting stories and be encouraged to answer questions on the story in pairs or in small groups.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Demonstrate awareness of pictures. print in and out of school. • Learners could be engaged in ‘read aloud’
2. Show interest in reading in and activities. out of school. • Learners could view pictures depicting a

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
